During autoregressive decoding, each new token requires a forward pass over the model, so the full set of weights (and often KV cache) must be read from memory for every generated token. At batch size 1, the amount of useful arithmetic per weight read is very small, giving low arithmetic intensity. Consequently, the time to move data through memory bandwidth dominates over compute time, making the step memory-bandwidth bound.
